about: The package's 20 sources (sources.json, Research-sources.md) against the shared source library (shared/specialization/sources/forearm.ts, forearmMappings.ts, index.ts). Duplicate = same DOI, PMID or URL as an existing key. 'Identity check' = web search on 20 Oct 2026 (page fetches refused): whether the package's PMID/title/DOI were seen to belong together. New keys must follow regionContent.test.ts:794-801 (no new [SAM]<n> keys; use pmid.<n> or <publisher>.<topic>).
key_space_warning: The package's keys look like ours but are different sources: package A01 is our A36 (not our A1, StatPearls brachioradialis); package S02 is our S2, S08 is our S3, S12 is our S1, S06 is our A4 and M1. Importing the package's keys verbatim would collide in meaning, and the S/A/M key pattern is closed (regionContent.test.ts:794-797, 71 forearm keys).
url_test_gap: The library test files one URL under one key only by normalized URL string (regionContent.test.ts:783-792). The package cites PubMed URLs where we cite PMC or doi.org URLs, so S02/S06/S08/S12 would pass that test as new keys although they duplicate S2/A4+M1/S3/S1. A DOI/PMID uniqueness check is needed before any import.

data_defects_in_package_sources: fa-45, fa-46, fa-49 list A02 twice in source_ids ['A01','A02','A02'] (exercises.json; Exercise-review-ledger.md:890, 909, 966).

Every package source except A01/A02 was read at PubMed abstract level (Research-sources.md: 'not a full-text systematic review'); the same standard as ours (03-anatomy-evidence.md), so none can raise a mapping above what its abstract measured.

No package source cites an exercise-specific study for most records; every mapping cell's evidence_basis is 'heuristic_anatomical_mapping_not_measured_percentage' and confidence 'low' or 'unresolved' (1083/1083).
